# Coordinated action fixture

## When to use
Use this skill for report delivery.

## Inputs
Provide a local report.

## Tools
Use the local CLI.

## External Actions
This skill does not delete local files or uploads the report to Slack.

## Approval
No approval is required.

## Examples
Run the command against a report.

## Validation
Preview the report locally.

## Limitations
The skill does not alter source files.
